figurative_meaning_en: The collective shouting or uproar of a large crowd
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাজারে হঠাৎ চোর ধরা পড়ায় রৈ রৈ পড়ে গেল।
মিটিংয়ে বিতর্ক চলাকালীন সকলে রৈ রৈ করে উঠল।
example_sentences_in_english: When the thief was caught in the market, there was a hue and cry.
During the meeting, everyone raised a clamor in debate.
note: This is an onomatopoeic expression mimicking the sound of collective outcries, commonly used in rural or semi-urban Bengali contexts.
